div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 245.109px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1 FIND SOURCES
Web addresses
and leads only

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 245.109px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2 APPLY
SOURCE RULES
Identity, purpose,
scope and access
Failure: rejected

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 245.109px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3 SAVE A COPY
Publisher, date, bytes,
checksum and version
Blocked: held

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 245.109px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6 VERIFY
SEPARATELY
Support, date, trust
and source record
Unsupported or
stale: held

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 245.109px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5 STRUCTURE
THE CLAIM
Company, measure,
value, period
and location

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 245.109px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4 FIND EXACT
SUPPORT
Passage must meet the
reporting cut-off
No support: held

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 245.109px; text-align: center;

span.p:
7 KEEP CONFLICTS
Competing evidence
remains visible
Unresolved: held

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 245.109px; text-align: center;

span.p:
8 NAMED APPROVAL
Decision matches the
current content hash
Missing or old:
no export

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 245.109px; text-align: center;

span.p:
APPROVED REPORT
OR EXPORT
Versioned file list
and output checksums

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 245.109px; text-align: center;

span.p:
THE RECORD
CANNOT SHOW
Whether the source
itself is true

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 504.219px; text-align: center;

span.p:
THE RECORD CAN SHOW
Origin, saved bytes, time,
checksum, location and decision
